# Baseball Savant Leaderboards (2024-2025)

20 Baseball Savant leaderboards for the **2024 and 2025 MLB regular seasons**, collected with [savant-extras](https://pypi.org/project/savant-extras/) **0.6.0**. Each CSV holds both seasons with a `year` (or `season`) column.

## Correction (September 2026)

The previous version of this dataset had errors, all caused by the way Baseball Savant handles a request it does not understand: it ignores the unknown parameter and returns **the current season**. savant-extras up to 0.5.0 sent several parameter names Savant no longer reads, so:

- **7 tables had the same table under 2024 and 2025**: `baserunning`, `basestealing`, `batted_ball`, `catcher_blocking`, `catcher_throwing`, `pitcher_arm_angle`, `running_game`.
- `swing_take` had **0 rows**.
- `catcher_stance` had **2 league-level rows per year** instead of one row per catcher.
- `pitch_movement` had **four-seam fastballs only**.
- `outs_above_average` had an **empty `year` column** (Savant leaves it blank), so the two seasons could not be told apart.
- `timer_infractions` had **2025 only**, and `year_to_year` had **2024 only**.

This version is rebuilt with savant-extras 0.6.0, which sends the parameters Savant reads and checks the season column of the tables that have one. The build script is public ([build.py](https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets/blob/main/savant-extras-dataset/build.py)): it also fetches each table for the current season (2026) and refuses to publish if any table is missing a season, is too small, has the same content for 2024 and 2025, or has a 2024 or 2025 slice equal to the current season. Those checks fail on the previous version for every table listed above.

## Files (20 CSVs)

| File | Category | Rows (2024 / 2025) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bat_tracking_2024_2025.csv` | Batting | {rows:bat_tracking} | Bat speed, attack angle, swing tilt (min 100 swings) |
| `batted_ball_2024_2025.csv` | Batting | {rows:batted_ball} | GB/FB/LD rates, pull/oppo splits (qualified) |
| `home_runs_2024_2025.csv` | Batting | {rows:home_runs} | HR totals, xHR (park-adjusted), no-doubters, mostly-gone |
| `swing_take_2024_2025.csv` | Batting | {rows:swing_take} | Swing/take run value by zone (Heart/Shadow/Chase/Waste). Savant's default list: the 300 batters who saw the most pitches |
| `year_to_year_2024_2025.csv` | Batting | {rows:year_to_year} | xwOBA for every season from 2015 to the current one (the 2026 column was still in progress when built), with year-over-year deltas; `year` is the season whose qualified batters are listed |
| `pitch_tempo_2024_2025.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitch_tempo} | Median seconds between pitches |
| `pitch_movement_2024_2025.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitch_movement} | Horizontal and vertical break for **every pitch type** (one row per pitcher and pitch type) |
| `pitcher_arm_angle_2024_2025.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitcher_arm_angle} | Arm angle and release point |
| `pitcher_quality_2024_2025.csv` | Pitching | {rows:pitcher_quality} | Stuff+, Location+, Pitching+ (FanGraphs, via pybaseball) |
| `running_game_2024_2025.csv` | Pitching | {rows:running_game} | Pitcher control of the running game |
| `timer_infractions_2024_2025.csv` | Pitching | {rows:timer_infractions} | Pitch clock violations by team |
| `arm_strength_2024_2025.csv` | Fielding | {rows:arm_strength} | Fielder throw speed by position (min 100 throws) |
| `outs_above_average_2024_2025.csv` | Fielding | {rows:outs_above_average} | OAA and fielding runs prevented (qualified fielders) |
| `outfield_jump_2024_2025.csv` | Fielding | {rows:outfield_jump} | Outfielder reaction, burst and route (via pybaseball) |
| `park_factors_2024_2025.csv` | Park | {rows:park_factors} | Park factors by team (FanGraphs) |
| `catcher_blocking_2024_2025.csv` | Catching | {rows:catcher_blocking} | Blocks above average |
| `catcher_throwing_2024_2025.csv` | Catching | {rows:catcher_throwing} | Pop time, CS above average, arm strength |
| `catcher_stance_2024_2025.csv` | Catching | {rows:catcher_stance} | One-knee vs traditional stance and its framing/blocking/throwing run value, **one row per catcher** |
| `baserunning_2024_2025.csv` | Baserunning | {rows:baserunning} | Baserunning run value |
| `basestealing_2024_2025.csv` | Baserunning | {rows:basestealing} | Stolen base run value, lead distances |

`outfield_jump`, `pitcher_quality` and `park_factors` are unchanged from the previous version: they were not affected (their 2024 and 2025 tables differ), and FanGraphs does not serve the build machine. They pass the same checks.

## How This Data Was Collected

```python
pip install savant-extras

from savant_extras import catcher_stance, pitch_movement
df = catcher_stance(2025)                   # one row per catcher
sl = pitch_movement(2025, pitch_type="SL")  # one pitch type per request
```

## Data Source

Data from [Baseball Savant](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/) (MLB Advanced Media) and [FanGraphs](https://www.fangraphs.com/) (`pitcher_quality`, `park_factors`). 2024 and 2025 regular seasons.
